lead_post.text:
Everyone is going all-in on AI.

https://t.co/queV9oPRcP just got EU approval for a ~$2.5B deal to acquire a European retail giant with 1,000+ physical stores.

Warehouses. Trucks. Stores. Real-world operations.

Sounds like the opposite of the AI revolution.

But here's the twist:

AI is making intelligence cheaper. That could make physical execution more valuable.

A model can choose the perfect refrigerator.

It can't deliver and install it.

When everyone has a brain, hands and feet become the moat.

My latest piece on why the next AI advantage might be built in the physical world.
https://t.co/MSWxDMc1Up

lead_post.translation_zh:
所有人都在全力押注 AI。

JD.com 刚刚获得欧盟批准，将以约 $2.5B 的交易收购一家拥有 1,000+ 家实体店的欧洲零售巨头。

仓库。卡车。门店。现实世界的运营。

听起来像是 AI 革命的反面。

但转折在这里：

AI 正在让智能变得更便宜。这可能会让实体执行变得更有价值。

一个模型可以选出完美的冰箱。

但它无法送货并安装。

当每个人都有大脑时，手和脚就成了护城河。

我的最新文章，讲述为什么下一个 AI 优势可能会建立在实体世界中。

featured_items.original_text: https://t.co/gjPpfTz5xA is making the biggest procurement bet in robotics: 3 million robots, 1 million autonomous vehicles and 100,000 drones over five years, backed by 80 robotics hubs and a plan to collect 10 million hours of real-world training data. The pitch is to be the infrastructure of the robotics industry — the data, the parts, the sales channel and the repair network — not just another robot maker. Founder Richard Liu was back at Wuzhen this week talking humanoid robots and AI — a sign of how central this bet has become. If JD delivers even half of it, the bottleneck for humanoids shifts from building robots to whoever owns the data and the service network. #JD #Robotics #EmbodiedAI #PhysicalAI
featured_items.translation_zh: JD.com 正在机器人领域进行最大规模的采购押注：未来五年采购 300 万台机器人、100 万辆自动驾驶车辆和 100,000 架无人机，并由 80 个机器人中心以及收集 1000 万小时真实世界训练数据的计划提供支持。其主张是成为机器人产业的基础设施——数据、零部件、销售渠道和维修网络——而不仅仅是又一家机器人制造商。创始人 Richard Liu 本周回到乌镇，谈论人形机器人和 AI——这表明这项押注已变得多么核心。如果 JD 哪怕实现其中一半，人形机器人的瓶颈就会从制造机器人转向谁拥有数据和服务网络。#JD #Robotics #EmbodiedAI #PhysicalAI

featured_items.original_text:
After calling and sending several emails to Sharp courier (with no response), I tracked the order on Temu and I kept calling the numbers.
Apparently, they have my order for the past 4 days and didn't reach out.
I don't want to shout coz I haven't received my package yet.
featured_items.translation_zh:
在给 Sharp courier 打电话并发送了几封邮件（没有回复）后，我在 Temu 上追踪了订单，并一直拨打那些号码。
显然，他们已经拿着我的订单 4 天了，却没有联系我。
我不想大吵大闹，因为我还没有收到我的包裹。
